context: Interactive data visualization with semantic zoom — density contours at low zoom, hexbins at medium, individual points at high zoom — showing 4 synthetic clusters
first_impression: Clean, restrained contour plot with a coherent blue gradient and generous whitespace that feels polished and intentional
what_works: Deliberate use of Paul Tol colorblind-friendly palette with per-mode badge color coding (blue/green/pink) adds meaningful visual feedback; typographic hierarchy is clear — bold title, compact monospace badge, and whisper-quiet hint text all occupy distinct visual registers
what_doesnt: Density contours flatten all 4 clusters into a single undifferentiated blue wash, losing cluster identity at the default zoom level where most users will land; no axis labels on x or y means the numeric ticks are unanchored to any real-world meaning, which reads as incomplete even for a demo
